coordinated_activities.activity: Working a rotating night shift as an aged-care support worker at a residential aged-care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning, hydration and overnight observation, and writing up detailed handover notes
Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, sitting quietly with earplugs in and reading the shift handover notes on his phone
Making a light post-shift breakfast of wholegrain toast and a pot of tea using the kettle and toaster, then rinsing and stacking his dishes quietly
Taking a warm shower with the water heater, washing up after the night shift and changing into clean sleep clothes
Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on low and the light off, phone set to silent, needing quiet for daytime recovery
Waking slowly, checking text messages on his phone and reviewing the written reminders and checklist that keep his routine on track
Eating a light flexitarian lunch of leftover rice, vegetables and chickpeas reheated in the microwave with a cup of tea, then washing up
Studying at his desk under the desk lamp, reading assigned Master of Social Work coursework on the computer and monitor and writing structured summary notes
Cooking and eating an early dinner of rice in the rice cooker with stir-fried vegetables and tofu on the induction cooker, then washing up and wiping the bench
Checking university unit announcements on the computer, replying to messages by text only and reviewing his upcoming shift roster to confirm dates in advance
Doing his weekly laundry, sorting light and dark items into the washing machine, transferring them to the clothes dryer and running the dehumidifier
Drafting part of a written social work assignment at his desk using the computer and monitor, following his detailed written plan step by step
Making a cup of tea with the kettle, having a small evening snack and tidying the kitchen surfaces and drying rack
Updating his weekly cash budget notebook, checking bills are predictable for the week and writing tomorrow's to-do list and reminders
Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
Quiet wind-down with the light dimmed and the fan on, looking at the photo of his family dog in China and listening to calm audio before sleep
Sleeping, with the room kept dark and quiet for the night
